title: replace_values: replace values in a single column
description: Replace string or numeric values in one column using an explicit mapping. Use this for standardizing labels, fixing typos, or replacing coded values.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Column where values should be replaced.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: Object mapping old values to new values.

rag_note: Only use replace_values when the user provides an explicit mapping or clear old/new value pair.
